notes: Use case: in-app product onboarding copilot to run guided flows (multi-step), drive activation + reduce support tickets.
Primary constraints: strict token cost caps per user journey (budgeted per MAU), and consistent latency for step transitions.

Latency targets discussed: streaming partials to user in <150-300ms typical, 95th <350ms, 99th <700ms for whole turn (tool-call inclusive). Team cares about perceived responsiveness more than raw throughput.
Token cost model: wants to cap tokens per session and be able to throttle or switch to cheaper quantized model for long sessions.

Model preference: prefer Llama/Redwood-verified open models for cost control; ready to evaluate Redwood defaults. Concerned about hallucination on help flows but ok with constrained tool calls and structured outputs.
Quote from PM: "We need the copilot to feel instant — if the step hangs the user drops off.  Token caps are part of our pricing assumptions."
Technical ask: streaming + function calling where tool calls return <200ms additional latency in normal case; fallback to cached answer acceptable for non-critical steps.
Security: must support SSO (SAML), company-wide audit logs, ability to hold PII only for 24h and support regional residency (EU customers). Legal requested a DPA + region controls.

POC notes: simulated 500 concurrent onboarding flows; hosted API handled median but showed tail latency on combos of long context + external tool calls. Need batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize and recommended quant/kv-cache config.
Commercial: asks for 12-mo reserved pricing example for Dedicated with burst capacity; wants clear switchback plan from Hosted->Dedicated mid-POC if SLA needed.
